import json, unittest
from pathlib import Path
import runner
class ExactCurbSweepOffline(unittest.TestCase):
 def test_exact_sweep_case_and_targets(self):
  root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
  cfg=json.loads((root/"config.json").read_text())
  route=runner.check_native_config(cfg,root/"source_geometry.json")
  self.assertEqual(route["branch"],cfg["case_branch"])
  self.assertTrue(cfg["selected_case_id"].endswith("__"+route["branch"]))
  self.assertEqual(route["approach"]["left_curb_offset_setpoint_m"],cfg["curb_offsets_m"]["approach"])
  self.assertEqual(route["departure"]["left_curb_offset_setpoint_m"],cfg["curb_offsets_m"]["departure"])
  self.assertFalse(route["actual_native_motion_verified"])
 def test_wrong_case_identity_or_source_rejected(self):
  root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
  cfg=json.loads((root/"config.json").read_text())
  original_case_id=cfg["selected_case_id"]
  cfg["selected_case_id"]+="-changed"
  with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,"case and route branch differ"):
   runner.check_native_config(cfg,root/"source_geometry.json")
  cfg["selected_case_id"]=original_case_id
  cfg["source_geometry_sha256"]="0"*64
  with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,"hash differs"):
   runner.check_native_config(cfg,root/"source_geometry.json")
